evidence.decision: Chooses chart versus searchable table from audience work; requires overview/group/individual inspection before stating an insight and preserves same-data encodings.
evidence.artifact: Delivers a computed takeaway, aggregation rationale and overview-detail map alongside the requested design, implementation or evidence-backed review.
evidence.transformation: Attendance dashboard replaces unreadable student marks and unrelated pie-to-line navigation with an evidence-supported trend and consistent drill-down metrics.
evidence.verification: Checks computed claim, subgroup meaning, selection continuity and accessible values; unsupported conclusions and silent metric changes explicitly fail.
evidence.applicability: Retains the source’s all-platform scope without inventing exclusions; separates data computation from native chart and assistive execution.
evidence.handoffs: Routes mark/scale work to Charts and record-oriented search/sort to Lists and tables only when those choices apply.
evidence.distinctiveness: Dataset provenance, aggregation and same-dataset visual continuity are charting decisions rather than a reusable component checklist.
